data.title: Investigation of the 6s6p 3P2-6s7s 3S1 transition of ytterbium atoms with modulation-transfer spectroscopy
data.authors: Qiao, H.; Liu, L.; Zhou, M.; Luo, L.; Xu, X.
data.notes: APL vol. 122, art. 224002 (2023). Modulation-transfer spectroscopy of the 770nm 3P2->3S1 transition in neutral Yb vapor. Measures 174Yb absolute frequency (389260605.8 ± 3.2 MHz) and isotope shifts for all stable isotopes except 168Yb and some 171Yb hyperfine states. Also determines hyperfine constants for 173Yb. Paper not accessible via open access; isotope shift and 173Yb hyperfine data pending direct extraction.
